main_text.p: שָׁהַר Syr. Vigilare, Partic. ܢܣܩܝܢ Vigilant pro animabus vestris, ad Hebraeos 13.17. Matth.26.38.40. Luc.21.36. Hinc & Ch. שְׁהִיר וְלֹא רָדִיךְ Vigilat & non dormit, Esth. 6.1. Quaedam exemplaria male scribunt per ר.

שְׁוָה Ch. & Syr. Æquari, adæquari, æqualem esse: commodum, utilem, dignum, aptum, idoneum esse, expedire, convenire, conveniens esse, Valere: & active, Æquare, adæquare, aesimilare, comparare. Item admirari, obstupescere, & sic idem quod תּוּה, Habac.1.5. Ithpehal אִשְׁתַּוֵּא, ܥܠܐ Chald. Æquari, adæquari, comparari, æstimari, similem, æqualem esse vel fieri. Syr. consentire, convenire, consentientem, parem, æqualem esse: Item Ch. Tremere, contremiscere, trepidare. Partic. וּמִשְׁתַּוֵּי לְקַבֵּל פְּתַגָּמִי Et trepidantem coram verbo meo, Jesa. 66.2. Regia habent מִשְׁתַּנִּי Mutantem, convertentem se: Sic & ibid. v. 5. Poni, reponi, collocari, Jobi 20.4. Ezech.1.15. Pahel שַׁוֵּי Ponere, apponere, deponere, imponere, reponere: Sternere, substernere, stratum ponere. Syriac. insuper, Æquare, abstergere, detergere, extergere, Luc.7.44. Joh.11.2. & 12.3. & 13.5. Ithpahel אִשְׁתַּוֵּי Poni, deponi, reponi. Aphel אַשְׁוֵי Syriac. Æqualem, parem facere, æquare, complanare, Matt.20.12. Joh.5.18. Matt.3.3. Æquum reddere, æquè judicare, ܩܕܡܐ Qui pof-

page.notes: Several Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are rendered approximately; Syriac and Hebrew forms are uncertain in places. Right edge of page is partly cut off at the last line.
